name: rock_weathered_limestone_side
what: the side of weathered limestone on a tall karst tower in warm wet country: the SAME pale limestone as the attached limestone side (its colours, grain and level lines), now streaked by rain: thin vertical darker streaks 1-2 px wide running down from the top edge (#9a9a88 #8a8e7c), a few with a faint grey-green tinge of algae (#8a9878 #7e8e70), small pits, the level lines softened. Overall still pale (no darker than #a8a490 on average). Seamless on all four edges, every cell filled, no border; streaks continue across the top and bottom edges so a tall wall reads as one face.
